answer: A workable defence is a reputation terrace: new agents start at the bottom with tiny transaction limits and must climb through verified, useful work before handling larger sums, like a jetty that only lets bigger boats dock once the channel is proven deep. Each level requires a time-locked stake slashed on fraud, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities pays the same real cost thousands of times. Yarrow grows slowly and cannot be rushed; reputation is the same, since time and consistent honest behaviour are the one input a sybil farmer cannot cheaply fake.
